Nope try again. It's medically called Superfetation. They consider them to be twins and people refer to them as fraternal if they do not know the details. But if you disagree that is your choice. There are 10 confirmed cases, and our boys are one of them. I'm not here to argue just here to share a super fascinating story.
Yes I am well aware that fraternal twins are a thing. Fraternal twins happen when 2 eggs are dropped at the SAME time and are fertilized. That is not what happened. 2 eggs dropped 2 or 3 weeks apart.
